items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I didn't even know that I was supposed to talk with this guy, the M.C., because after it was over, I walked off and he's supposed to be carrying on a conversation with me

ctx.x: I couldn't believe it. I said, what the hell is going on. We're going on the air in ten minutes, here's what you do; this guy's going to introduce you. Man, why didn't you tell me about this, why did you let me come like this. That's how that happened.

I didn't even know that I was supposed to talk with this guy, the M.C., because after it was over, I walked off and he's supposed to be carrying on a conversation with me and I'm not even there; I didn't have a script, I didn't know what was happening. I left; finished the last piece of music and walked off and he's saying
yeah, that's very good, George, what about the-- and I'm not there, so he had to ad lib himself out of it.
